open_points.subject: Effect-class comparison in invocation outcomes
open_points.text: "EFFECT_CLASSES is read by `flows` ... and by `effects` ...; no other module compares effect classes." / "`service_invoker` Owns A09 ... the outcome table of A09 rule 5" (which branches on `read` vs non-`read`).
open_points.question: Which module is responsible for comparing an operation's effect class for A09 outcome mapping (`read` vs non-`read`): `effects` or `service_invoker`?
options: `effects` compares effect class and calls `service_invoker` in an explicit mode
`service_invoker` compares effect class itself from the operation/binding it receives
open_points.default_guess: `effects` compares and passes mode, to keep the "no other module compares effect classes" rule true.

open_points.subject: Inspection read path vs raw-store prohibition
open_points.text: "A module reads what a module it may know owns through that module's capability, and never decides from another module's raw records" and "`surface` ... assembles ... from the owning modules' read capabilities and `store.page_records`".
open_points.question: May `surface` directly read and interpret raw records via `store.page_records` for inspect/read-trace responses, or must every inspected record type be exposed through owner-module read capabilities only?
options: `surface` may use raw `store.page_records` and apply interpretation/masking itself
`surface` may page only opaque IDs/positions from store and must obtain record meaning via owner-module reads
open_points.default_guess: Use owner-module read capabilities for record meaning; keep `store.page_records` as pagination/index support only.

open_points.subject: Startup spool cleanup ownership
open_points.text: A18 rule 4 says: "On start, temporary files and the spool directories of runs that ended and do not keep their spool ... are removed"; State 3 start sequence says `store.open_store` removes temporary files, then `runs.recover_running_runs` "first names to `store.remove_run_spool` every ended run that no longer keeps its spool".
open_points.question: Who owns deciding and executing start-time removal of ended-run spool directories: `store.open_store` or `runs.recover_running_runs`?
options: `store.open_store` both identifies eligible runs and removes their spools
`runs.recover_running_runs` identifies eligible runs; `store` only performs removal by explicit run IDs
open_points.default_guess: `runs` decides eligibility; `store` performs only explicit removals.
